message.reasoning_content:
We need to identify crimes based on Chinese criminal law. Facts: selling pirated CDs for profit. This is infringement of copyright. The relevant criminal provision is "侵犯著作权罪" (Crime of infringing copyright). Also possibly "非法经营罪"? But the main is "侵犯著作权罪". Also "非法买卖盗版光盘" could be "非法出版罪"? Actually Chinese law: Criminal Law article 219: "侵犯著作权罪" includes illegal reproduction, distribution, etc. So the charge is "侵犯著作权罪". Also maybe "非法经营罪" if large scale? But the facts mention selling 1900 CDs, purchased 3500-4000. Could be "非法经营罪" under article 225 for illegal business of copyrighted works? However typical case: selling pirated CDs is prosecuted as "侵犯著作权罪". So answer: [罪名]侵犯著作权罪<eoa>.

Check format: need [罪名]...<eoa>. So: [罪名]侵犯著作权罪<eoa>.
